facts.value: Responsible for handling different biological samples, testing, and screening lifestyle ailments. They also discover and develop treatment aids such as medicines and drugs.

Responsible for teaching and delivering lectures at the university level and guiding students in the related discipline to identify their strengths and interests. They also help students understand how to harness and pursue these strengths and interests.
Responsible for designing systems and products for devices for replacing body parts and helping diagnose medical issues. They also work on creating artificial organs.
Responsible for dispensing and managing medicines. They also take care of the overall health of patients in the setting of dispensaries or pharmacies.
Responsible for processing specimens, preparing experimental setups and equipment, and managing the lab. They can work in hospitals and pharmaceutical companies.
Responsible for collaborating with sales teams to understand and deliver customer requirements. They also promote the sales of the company's products and enhance overall company sales.
